contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ AELFR EDREX ; R/ +B / VR / GNN / OD (NN

An early medieval silver penny of Alfred 'the Great' of Wessex (871-899), portrait type (N 629),. Obverse description: Bust diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: AELFR EDREX. Reverse description: Long cross with central rhomboid containing central cross and three triangles. Reverse inscription: +B / VR / GNN / OD (NN ligated; probably moneyer Burgnoth).
